name: check-laravel
description: Run the standard Laravel PHP check suite (PHPStan, Pint, PHP Insights, PHPMD, tests) and report via reviewdog.

github-token.description: GitHub token for reviewdog reporting, shared by every wrapped check.

paths.description: Comma-separated list of paths to analyze with PHPStan, Pint, PHP Insights and PHPMD.  Defaults to `app`, filtered by `dirty` and `wip` if enabled.  Shared by every wrapped check that supports it (PHPStan, Pint, PHP Insights, PHPMD).

dirty.description: Only analyze files with uncommitted git changes, shared by every wrapped check that supports it (PHPStan, Pint, PHP Insights, PHPMD).

wip.description: Only analyze files changed on the current pull request (relative to its base branch), shared by every wrapped check that supports it (PHPStan, Pint, PHP Insights, PHPMD).

wip-base-ref.description: Base branch/ref to diff against when `wip` is enabled. Defaults to `GITHUB_BASE_REF`, which GitHub Actions sets automatically on `pull_request` events.

pint-blade.description: Format `.blade.php` files too when Pint runs (Pint's `--blade` flag, added in Pint 1.30). Requires `prettier`, `prettier-plugin-blade` and `prettier-plugin-tailwindcss` available in the repository.

tests.description: Whether to run the test suite.

level.description: Report level for reviewdog [info,warning,error], shared by every wrapped check.

fail-level.description: Exit code for reviewdog if it finds at least the specified level of diagnostic [none,any,info,warning,error], shared by every wrapped check.

reviewdog-flags.description: Additional reviewdog flags, shared by every wrapped check.

coverage-file.description: Path of the generated coverage report, empty when no report was produced.

junit-file.description: Path of the generated JUnit report, empty when no report was produced.
